echo _DMK_MODEL_; getprop ro.product.model 2>/dev/null; echo _DMK_BRAND_; getprop ro.product.brand 2>/dev/null; echo _DMK_ANDROID_; getprop ro.build.version.release 2>/dev/null; echo _DMK_SDK_; getprop ro.build.version.sdk 2>/dev/null; echo _DMK_SERIAL_; getprop ro.serialno 2>/dev/null; echo _DMK_POWER_; dumpsys power 2>/dev/null; echo _DMK_WINDOW_; dumpsys window 2>/dev/null; echo _DMK_BATTERY_; dumpsys battery 2>/dev/null; echo _DMK_STAY_; settings get global stay_on_while_plugged_in 2>/dev/null; echo _DMK_ADBWIFI_; settings get global adb_wifi_enabled 2>/dev/null; echo _DMK_SIZE_; wm size 2>/dev/null; echo _DMK_DENSITY_; wm density 2>/dev/null; echo _DMK_BRIGHT_; settings get system screen_brightness_mode 2>/dev/null
